title: Joram (king of Israel)
summary: King of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Ahab. Not Jehoram of Judah. Jones dates his accession.
description: King of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Ahab. Not Jehoram of Judah. Jones dates his accession. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Ussher–Jones). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: 3107 897 Joram becomes king over Israel.

reign.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
reign.note: This is Joram of Israel, not jehoram-of-judah. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.
